#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only decoder and paired comparator for sealed Conductor admission captures."""
import argparse
import base64
import collections
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys

SCHEMA = 'conductor-must-demand-snapshot-v1'
CAPTURE = 'BIDI_CONDUCTOR_CALL_ADMISSION_CAPTURE'
DROP = 'BIDI_CONDUCTOR_CALL_ADMISSION_WHOLE_DROP'
STATS = 'BIDI_CONDUCTOR_CALL_ADMISSION_STATS'
LAYERS = {'NORMAL', 'DEMAND'}
TAILS = {'STAR', 'ANY', 'ANY_TAINT', 'EXACT'}
ERROR_COUNTERS = ('wholeDropped', 'eventCapDropped', 'sizeDropped', 'totalCapDropped',
                  'diagnosticErrors', 'sinkErrors', 'controlCapSuppressed')
LIMITS = ('This is selected call-level admission plus an explicit local demand snapshot, not global callee history. '
          'Unmatched inputs are not absence evidence. Drops, caps, partial data, invalid events, '
          'bad controls, or unverified identity prerequisites make wider conclusions UNKNOWN. '
          'No causal, quality, convergence, or performance claim is made.')
CALLER = 'com.netflix.conductor.core.execution.WorkflowExecutorOps#startWorkflow(com.netflix.conductor.core.execution.StartWorkflowInput)'
CALLEE = 'com.netflix.conductor.core.execution.WorkflowExecutorOps#createAndEvaluate(com.netflix.conductor.model.WorkflowModel)'
GRAAL = 'java/security/graaljs-polyglot-code-injection.yaml:graaljs-polyglot-code-injection#spring-source;0;$UNTRUSTED;2'
WFDEF = {'kind': 'FIELD', 'className': 'com.netflix.conductor.model.WorkflowModel',
         'fieldName': 'workflowDefinition', 'fieldType': 'com.netflix.conductor.common.metadata.workflow.WorkflowDef'}


def selected_method(method):
    return method['method'] == CALLEE and method['methodName'] == 'createAndEvaluate'


class Invalid(ValueError):
    pass


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise Invalid(message)


def canonical(value):
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':'))


def digest(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical(value).encode()).hexdigest()


def file_sha(path):
    hasher = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1048576), b''):
            hasher.update(block)
    return hasher.hexdigest()


def no_duplicate_keys(pairs):
    result = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        require(key not in result, 'Duplicate JSON key: ' + key)
        result[key] = value
    return result


def loads(text):
    return json.loads(text, object_pairs_hook=no_duplicate_keys)


def integer(value, label, minimum=0):
    require(type(value) is int and value >= minimum, 'Invalid integer ' + label)
    return value


def string(value, label):
    require(isinstance(value, str) and bool(value), 'Missing or empty string ' + label)
    return value


def unique_array(values, label):
    require(isinstance(values, list), 'Missing array ' + label)
    require(len(values) == len({canonical(v) for v in values}), 'Duplicate entries in ' + label)
    return values


def sorted_set(values):
    return sorted(values, key=canonical)


class Normalizer:
    def __init__(self, envelope):
        require(envelope.get('schema') == SCHEMA and envelope.get('run') == 3, 'Envelope schema/run')
        require(envelope.get('wholeNativeEventIncluded') is True, 'Incomplete native envelope')
        require(envelope.get('completeTypedFieldCatalog') is True, 'Incomplete typed field catalog')
        self.native = loads(string(envelope.get('nativeEvent'), 'nativeEvent'))
        native = self.native
        require(native.get('schema') == SCHEMA and native.get('run') == 3, 'Native schema/run')
        require(native.get('sequence') == envelope.get('sequence'), 'Sequence mismatch')
        require(native.get('direction') == 'FORWARD', 'Wrong direction')
        require(native.get('completeInputAndReturnedList') is True, 'Incomplete tuple/list')
        require(native.get('catalogIncluded') is True, 'Missing native catalog')
        self.fields, self.marks = {}, {}
        self.used_fields, self.used_marks = set(), set()
        count = integer(envelope.get('typedFieldCount'), 'typedFieldCount')
        typed_entries = collections.defaultdict(dict)
        for key, value in envelope.items():
            match = re.fullmatch(r'typedField\.(\d+)\.(.+)', key)
            if match:
                typed_entries[int(match.group(1))][match.group(2)] = value
        require(set(typed_entries) == set(range(count)), 'Typed field count/index mismatch')
        for ordinal in range(count):
            prefix = 'typedField.' + str(ordinal) + '.'
            item = typed_entries[ordinal]
            fid = integer(item.get('id'), prefix + 'id')
            require(fid not in self.fields, 'Duplicate typed field ID')
            kind = string(item.get('kind'), prefix + 'kind')
            cls = string(item.get('javaClass'), prefix + 'javaClass')
            if kind == 'FIELD':
                require(cls.endswith('.FieldAccessor'), 'FIELD accessor class mismatch')
                descriptor = {'kind': kind, 'className': string(item.get('className'), prefix + 'className'),
                              'fieldName': string(item.get('fieldName'), prefix + 'fieldName'),
                              'fieldType': string(item.get('fieldType'), prefix + 'fieldType')}
            elif kind == 'CLASS_STATIC':
                require(cls.endswith('.ClassStaticAccessor'), 'STATIC accessor class mismatch')
                descriptor = {'kind': kind, 'typeName': string(item.get('typeName'), prefix + 'typeName')}
            else:
                singletons = {'ElementAccessor', 'FinalAccessor', 'AnyAccessor', 'ValueAccessor', 'TypeInfoGroupAccessor'}
                require(kind in singletons and cls.endswith('.' + kind), 'Unsupported special accessor kind')
                descriptor = {'kind': kind, 'javaClass': cls}
            self.fields[fid] = descriptor
        require(len({canonical(v) for v in self.fields.values()}) == len(self.fields), 'Duplicate logical field descriptor')
        native_fields = native.get('fields')
        require(isinstance(native_fields, list), 'Missing native fields')
        ids = [integer(item.get('id'), 'native field ID') for item in native_fields]
        require(len(ids) == len(set(ids)) and set(ids) == set(self.fields), 'Typed/native field catalogs differ')
        catalog = native.get('marks')
        require(isinstance(catalog, list), 'Missing mark catalog')
        for item in catalog:
            mid = integer(item.get('id'), 'mark ID')
            require(mid not in self.marks, 'Duplicate mark ID')
            name, key = string(item.get('name'), 'logical mark name'), string(item.get('key'), 'mark key')
            if key == 'ControlZero':
                require(name == '<zero>', 'Invalid ZERO mark name')
                kind = 'ZERO'
            elif key.startswith('Full('):
                kind = 'FULL'
            elif key.startswith('Group('):
                kind = 'GROUP'
            else:
                raise Invalid('Unknown mark catalog key kind')
            self.marks[mid] = {'kind': kind, 'name': name}
        require(len({canonical(v) for v in self.marks.values()}) == len(self.marks), 'Duplicate logical mark identity')
        nodes = native.get('nodes')
        require(isinstance(nodes, list), 'Missing DAG nodes')
        self.nodes = {}
        for node in nodes:
            nid = integer(node.get('id'), 'DAG node ID')
            require(nid not in self.nodes, 'Duplicate DAG node ID')
            self.nodes[nid] = node
        self.node_hashes = {}

    def field(self, fid):
        integer(fid, 'field reference')
        require(fid in self.fields, 'Uncatalogued field ID ' + str(fid))
        self.used_fields.add(fid)
        return self.fields[fid]

    def mark(self, mid):
        integer(mid, 'mark reference')
        require(mid in self.marks, 'Uncatalogued mark ID ' + str(mid))
        self.used_marks.add(mid)
        return self.marks[mid]

    def field_set(self, values, name):
        return sorted_set([self.field(v) for v in unique_array(values, name)])

    def mark_set(self, values, name):
        return sorted_set([self.mark(v) for v in unique_array(values, name)])

    def slot(self, value):
        require(isinstance(value, dict), 'Missing mark slot')
        if value.get('kind') == 'FLOW':
            return {'kind': 'FLOW', 'mx': self.mark_set(value.get('mx'), 'slot.mx')}
        require(value.get('kind') == 'CONCRETE', 'Unknown mark slot kind')
        return {'kind': 'CONCRETE', 'mark': self.mark(value.get('id'))}

    def initial(self, value):
        require(isinstance(value, dict), 'Missing initial member')
        integer(value.get('id'), 'local initial ID')
        tail = value.get('tail')
        require(tail in TAILS, 'Invalid initial tail')
        path = value.get('path')
        require(isinstance(path, list), 'Missing initial path')
        return {'baseType': string(value.get('baseType'), 'initial.baseType'),
                'base': string(value.get('base'), 'initial.base'),
                'path': [self.field(v) for v in path], 'tail': tail,
                'E': self.field_set(value.get('E'), 'initial.E'), 'mark': self.slot(value.get('mark'))}

    def pattern(self, value, label='row pattern'):
        require(isinstance(value, dict), 'Missing ' + label)
        require(value.get('tail') in TAILS, 'Invalid ' + label + ' tail')
        require(isinstance(value.get('path'), list), 'Missing ' + label + ' path')
        return {'baseType': string(value.get('baseType'), label + '.baseType'),
                'base': string(value.get('base'), label + '.base'),
                'path': [self.field(v) for v in value['path']], 'tail': value['tail'],
                'E': self.field_set(value.get('E'), label + '.E'), 'mark': self.slot(value.get('mark'))}

    def snapshot(self):
        value = self.native
        require(value.get('completeExplicitLocalRows') is True, 'Incomplete explicit local rows')
        require(value.get('demandSnapshotHasStaticCompletion') is False, 'Static completion present or unknown')
        require(value.get('demandSnapshotHasSharedStaticCarry') is False, 'Shared static carry present or unknown')
        require(value.get('demandSnapshotProjection') == 'EXPLICIT_LOCAL_NONSTATIC_DATA_AND_ZERO_ROWS',
                'Unknown demand snapshot projection')
        require(value.get('demandSnapshotTargetEntryRowsOmitted') is True and
                value.get('demandSnapshotTargetEntriesCannotMatchSelectedData') is True,
                'Missing Target-entry projection qualification')
        count = integer(value.get('explicitDemandRowCount'), 'explicitDemandRowCount')
        require(count <= 4096, 'Explicit row count exceeds source bound')
        entries = collections.defaultdict(dict)
        for name, item in value.items():
            match = re.fullmatch(r'explicitDemandRow\.(\d+)\.(.+)', name)
            if match: entries[int(match.group(1))][match.group(2)] = item
        require(set(entries) == set(range(count)), 'Explicit row count/index mismatch')
        rows = []
        for ordinal in range(count):
            row = entries[ordinal]
            require(type(row.get('hasExit')) is bool, 'Missing row hasExit')
            require(set(row) == ({'entry', 'hasExit', 'exit'} if row['hasExit'] else {'entry', 'hasExit'}),
                    'Incomplete or extra explicit paired row fields')
            rows.append({'entry': self.pattern(row['entry'], 'row.entry'),
                         'exit': self.pattern(row['exit'], 'row.exit') if row['hasExit'] else None})
        paired = sum(row['exit'] is not None for row in rows)
        require(value.get('explicitDemandPairedRowCount') == paired and
                value.get('explicitDemandEntryOnlyRowCount') == count - paired,
                'Explicit paired/entry-only count mismatch')
        unique = {canonical(row): row for row in rows}
        return {'projection': value['demandSnapshotProjection'], 'hasStaticCompletion': False,
                'hasSharedStaticCarry': False, 'targetEntryRowsOmitted': True,
                'targetEntryCannotMatchSelectedData': True, 'complete': True,
                'rowCount': count, 'pairedRowCount': paired, 'entryOnlyRowCount': count - paired,
                'rowsInOrder': rows, 'rowOrderDigest': digest(rows),
                'rowMultisetDigest': digest(sorted_set(rows)),
                'rowSet': [unique[k] for k in sorted(unique)], 'rowSetDigest': digest([unique[k] for k in sorted(unique)])}

    def premise(self, value):
        require(isinstance(value, dict), 'Missing premise')
        kind, members = value.get('kind'), value.get('members')
        require(kind in {'ZERO', 'INITIAL', 'ND'} and isinstance(members, list), 'Invalid premise')
        require(len(members) >= 2 if kind == 'ND' else len(members) == 1, 'Premise member count')
        normalized = [self.initial(v) for v in members]
        require(len({canonical(v) for v in normalized}) == len(normalized), 'Duplicate premise semantic members')
        return {'kind': kind, 'members': sorted_set(normalized)}

    def dag(self, root, expected_kind):
        require(type(root) is int and root in self.nodes, 'Missing DAG root')
        # Iterative postorder: one digest per physical node, no logical path expansion.
        stack, active = [(root, False)], set()
        while stack:
            nid, finish = stack.pop()
            if nid in self.node_hashes:
                require(self.node_hashes[nid][0] == expected_kind, 'Mixed FLOW/TAINT DAG use')
                continue
            node = self.nodes[nid]
            children = node.get('children')
            require(isinstance(children, list), 'Missing DAG children')
            if not finish:
                require(nid not in active, 'Cyclic DAG')
                active.add(nid)
                child_ids, fields = [], []
                for child in children:
                    fid = integer(child.get('field'), 'DAG child field')
                    cid = integer(child.get('node'), 'DAG child node')
                    require(cid in self.nodes, 'Unresolved DAG child')
                    fields.append(fid)
                    child_ids.append(cid)
                require(len(fields) == len(set(fields)), 'Duplicate child edge field')
                stack.append((nid, True))
                for cid in reversed(child_ids):
                    if cid in active:
                        raise Invalid('Cyclic DAG')
                    if cid not in self.node_hashes:
                        stack.append((cid, False))
            else:
                if expected_kind == 'FLOW':
                    require(type(node.get('flowLeaf')) is bool and 'exact' not in node and 'any' not in node,
                            'Invalid FLOW leaf')
                    leaf = {'flowLeaf': node['flowLeaf']}
                else:
                    require('flowLeaf' not in node, 'Invalid TAINT leaf')
                    leaf = {'exact': self.mark_set(node.get('exact'), 'node.exact'),
                            'any': self.mark_set(node.get('any'), 'node.any')}
                edges = [[self.field(c['field']), self.node_hashes[c['node']][1]] for c in children]
                self.node_hashes[nid] = (expected_kind, digest({'leaf': leaf, 'children': sorted_set(edges)}))
                active.remove(nid)
        return self.node_hashes[root][1]

    def facts(self, value):
        require(isinstance(value, dict), 'Missing actual facts')
        kind = value.get('kind')
        require(kind in {'FLOW', 'TAINT'}, 'Reach/non-runtime actual offer')
        require(value.get('layer') in LAYERS and value.get('tail') in TAILS, 'Actual layer/tail')
        result = {'kind': kind, 'baseType': string(value.get('baseType'), 'actual.baseType'),
                  'base': string(value.get('base'), 'actual.base'), 'layer': value['layer'],
                  'tail': value['tail'], 'E': self.field_set(value.get('E'), 'actual.E'),
                  'rootDigest': self.dag(value.get('root'), kind), 'protectionDigest': None}
        if kind == 'FLOW':
            require(value.get('protection') is None, 'FLOW protection must be null')
            result['mx'] = self.mark_set(value.get('mx'), 'actual.mx')
        elif value.get('protection') is not None:
            result['protectionDigest'] = self.dag(value['protection'], kind)
        return result

    def method(self, name):
        value = self.native
        encoded = string(value.get(name + '.contextNativeBase64'), name + '.contextNativeBase64')
        try:
            binary = base64.b64decode(encoded, validate=True)
        except ValueError as error:
            raise Invalid('Invalid context Base64') from error
        require(bool(binary), 'Empty native context serialization')
        count = integer(value.get(name + '.parameterCount'), 'parameterCount')
        entry = value.get(name + '.entryIndex')
        integer(entry, 'method entry index', -2147483648)
        return {'method': string(value.get(name + '.method'), name + '.method'),
                'methodName': string(value.get(name + '.methodName'), name + '.methodName'),
                'parameters': [string(value.get(name + '.parameter.' + str(i)), 'parameter type') for i in range(count)],
                'returnType': string(value.get(name + '.returnType'), 'return type'), 'entryIndex': entry,
                'contextCodec': string(value.get(name + '.contextCodec'), 'context codec'),
                'contextNativeBase64': base64.b64encode(binary).decode()}

    def event(self, raw_ref):
        native = self.native
        snapshot = self.snapshot()  # Normalize row catalogs before the whole-event catalog closure checks.
        for key in ('actualLayer', 'callerLayer', 'linkLayer'):
            require(native.get(key) in LAYERS, 'Invalid ' + key)
        require(type(native.get('zeroOnly')) is bool, 'Missing zeroOnly')
        require(native.get('hook') in {'enterCallees', 'zeroAtCall'}, 'Invalid hook')
        key = {'run': 3, 'direction': 'FORWARD', 'hook': native['hook'],
               'fieldLimit': integer(native.get('fieldLimit'), 'fieldLimit', 1),
               'markMode': string(native.get('markMode'), 'markMode'),
               'caller': self.method('caller'), 'callee': self.method('callee'),
               'physicalCallIndex': integer(native.get('physicalCallIndex'), 'physicalCallIndex', -2147483648),
               'callerScopeBlock': integer(native.get('callerScopeBlock'), 'callerScopeBlock'),
               'callerScopeEntry': integer(native.get('callerScopeEntry'), 'callerScopeEntry', -2147483648),
               'stageOrdinal': integer(native.get('stageOrdinal'), 'stageOrdinal'),
               'originalP': self.premise(native.get('originalP')), 'actualFacts': self.facts(native.get('actualFacts')),
               'actualLayer': native['actualLayer'], 'callerLayer': native['callerLayer'],
               'linkLayer': native['linkLayer'], 'zeroOnly': native['zeroOnly']}
        require(key['markMode'] == 'FULL', 'Run-3 mode must be FULL')
        require(selected_method(key['callee']) and key['caller']['method'] == CALLER, 'Outside exact method selector')
        require(key['physicalCallIndex'] == 9 and key['callerScopeBlock'] == 0 and key['callerScopeEntry'] == -1,
                'Outside selected ROOT call9')
        actual = key['actualFacts']
        require(actual['kind'] == 'TAINT' and actual['base'] == 'arg(0)' and actual['tail'] == 'ANY_TAINT' and
                actual['layer'] == 'NORMAL' and not actual['E'] and actual['protectionDigest'] is None,
                'Outside selected normal MUST actual')
        root = self.nodes[native['actualFacts']['root']]
        require(len(self.nodes) == 2 and root.get('exact') == [] and root.get('any') == [] and
                len(root['children']) == 1, 'Outside selected two-node root')
        edge = root['children'][0]
        require(self.field(edge['field']) == WFDEF, 'Wrong selected full typed field')
        head = self.nodes[edge['node']]
        require(head.get('children') == [] and head.get('exact') == [] and
                self.mark_set(head.get('any'), 'head.any') == [{'kind': 'FULL', 'name': GRAAL}],
                'Outside selected uniform Graal head')
        require(key['actualLayer'] == key['actualFacts']['layer'] == key['linkLayer'], 'Actual/link layer mismatch')
        returned, local_ids = [], []
        count = integer(native.get('admittedInitialCount'), 'admittedInitialCount')
        for ordinal in range(count):
            prefix = 'admittedInitial.' + str(ordinal)
            premise = native.get(prefix + '.initial')
            normalized = self.premise(premise)
            require(normalized['kind'] in {'ZERO', 'INITIAL'}, 'Returned admission is not a single initial')
            layer = native.get(prefix + '.layer')
            require(layer in LAYERS, 'Invalid returned initial layer')
            returned.append({'pattern': normalized['members'][0], 'layer': layer})
            local_ids.append(premise['members'][0]['id'])
        indexed = {int(m.group(1)) for keyname in native for m in [re.match(r'admittedInitial\.(\d+)\.', keyname)] if m}
        require(indexed == set(range(count)), 'Returned list count/index mismatch')
        require(len({canonical(v) for v in returned}) == count, 'Returned list contains duplicate semantic initial/layer')
        require(self.used_fields == set(self.fields), 'Unused or incomplete field catalog')
        require(self.used_marks == set(self.marks), 'Unused or incomplete mark catalog')
        require(set(self.node_hashes) == set(self.nodes), 'Unreachable or incomplete DAG catalog')
        result = {'sequence': integer(native.get('sequence'), 'sequence', 1), 'raw': raw_ref,
                  'semanticInputDigest': digest(key), 'semanticInput': key,
                  'initialSet': sorted_set(returned), 'initialOrder': returned,
                  'initialSetDigest': digest(sorted_set(returned)), 'initialOrderDigest': digest(returned),
                  'localReturnedInitialIds': local_ids,
                  'physicalDagNodes': len(self.nodes), 'logicalPathsEnumerated': 0}
        query = {name: key[name] for name in ('run', 'direction', 'fieldLimit', 'markMode', 'callee', 'actualFacts')}
        result['demandSnapshot'] = snapshot
        snapshot_key = {name: key[name] for name in ('run', 'direction', 'fieldLimit', 'markMode', 'callee')}
        result['demandSnapshotKey'] = snapshot_key
        result['demandSnapshotKeyDigest'] = digest(snapshot_key)
        result['flowAnyCoordinateRows'] = flow_any_rows(snapshot['rowsInOrder'])
        result['admissionQuery'] = query
        result['admissionQueryDigest'] = digest(query)
        result['localOriginalPremiseMembers'] = [{'localId': member['id'], 'pattern': self.initial(member)}
                                                for member in native['originalP']['members']]
        result['calleeInitialDeliveryScope'] = {'block': 0, 'entry': -1,
            'sourceContract': 'startInitials(callee, initials) uses the method-root actor; block propagation is separate'}
        result['classificationCounts'] = dict(collections.Counter(classify(v)['tailClass'] for v in returned))
        return result


def flow_any_rows(rows):
    result = []
    for ordinal, row in enumerate(rows):
        entry = row['entry']
        if entry['base'] != 'arg(0)' or entry['tail'] != 'ANY' or entry['mark'] != {'kind': 'FLOW', 'mx': []}:
            continue
        coordinate = 'ROOT_ANY_FLOW' if not entry['path'] else (
            'WORKFLOW_DEFINITION_ANY_FLOW' if entry['path'] == [WFDEF] else 'OTHER_ANY_FLOW')
        result.append({'ordinal': ordinal, 'coordinate': coordinate, 'row': row})
    return result


def snapshot_summary(events):
    grouped = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for event in events: grouped[event['demandSnapshotKeyDigest']].append(event)
    result = []
    for key, values in sorted(grouped.items()):
        sets = {e['demandSnapshot']['rowSetDigest'] for e in values}
        multisets = {e['demandSnapshot']['rowMultisetDigest'] for e in values}
        result.append({'keyDigest': key, 'key': values[0]['demandSnapshotKey'],
            'occurrences': len(values), 'snapshotConstant': len(sets) == len(multisets) == 1,
            'rowSetDigests': sorted(sets), 'rowMultisetDigests': sorted(multisets),
            'representativeRaw': values[0]['raw'], 'representativeSequence': values[0]['sequence'],
            'rowCount': values[0]['demandSnapshot']['rowCount'],
            'flowAnyCoordinateRows': values[0]['flowAnyCoordinateRows']})
    return result


def compare_snapshots(current, paired):
    a, b = query_groups(current['events']), query_groups(paired['events'])
    matched, ambiguous = [], []
    for key in sorted(a.keys() & b.keys()):
        left, right = a[key], b[key]
        require(left[0]['admissionQuery'] == right[0]['admissionQuery'], 'Query hash collision')
        la = {e['demandSnapshot']['rowMultisetDigest'] for e in left}
        rb = {e['demandSnapshot']['rowMultisetDigest'] for e in right}
        item = {'admissionQueryDigest': key, 'admissionQuery': left[0]['admissionQuery'],
                'currentRaw': [e['raw'] for e in left], 'pairedBRaw': [e['raw'] for e in right]}
        if len(la) != 1 or len(rb) != 1:
            ambiguous.append(dict(item, reason='Frozen snapshot differs within one variant/query'))
            continue
        ca, cb = left[0]['demandSnapshot'], right[0]['demandSnapshot']
        aa, bb = {canonical(r): r for r in ca['rowSet']}, {canonical(r): r for r in cb['rowSet']}
        current_roots = [r for r in left[0]['flowAnyCoordinateRows'] if r['coordinate'] == 'ROOT_ANY_FLOW']
        b_children = [r for r in right[0]['flowAnyCoordinateRows'] if r['coordinate'] == 'WORKFLOW_DEFINITION_ANY_FLOW']
        root_child_pairs = []
        for cr in current_roots:
            for br in b_children:
                ce, be = cr['row']['entry'], br['row']['entry']
                if cr['row']['exit'] is not None and cr['row']['exit'] == br['row']['exit'] and all(
                    ce[k] == be[k] for k in ('baseType','base','tail','E','mark')):
                    root_child_pairs.append({'currentRootRow': cr, 'pairedBChildRow': br,
                        'pairedExitEqual': True, 'emissionAttributionObserved': False})
        matched.append(dict(item, currentSnapshot=ca, pairedBSnapshot=cb,
            extraPairedBRows=[bb[k] for k in sorted(bb.keys()-aa.keys())],
            extraCurrentRows=[aa[k] for k in sorted(aa.keys()-bb.keys())],
            rootAndChildRowsWithSamePairedExit=root_child_pairs,
            returnedInitialComparison={'current': left[0]['initialSet'], 'pairedB': right[0]['initialSet']},
            exactDemandRowToInitialAttribution='SOURCE_POLICY_REASONING_REQUIRED',
            originalPAndCallTransactionEqual=left[0]['semanticInput'] == right[0]['semanticInput']))
    return {'scope': 'same complete structural actual query and full callee native context; explicit local paired rows only',
        'counts': {'matchingQueries': len(matched), 'ambiguousQueries': len(ambiguous),
                   'rootChildEqualExitPairs': sum(len(m['rootAndChildRowsWithSamePairedExit']) for m in matched)},
        'matches': matched, 'ambiguous': ambiguous, 'globalAbsence': 'UNKNOWN',
        'targetEntryRowsOmittedBecauseSelectedQueryIsData': True, 'policyChanged': False}


def classify(admission):
    pattern = admission['pattern']
    return {'tailClass': {'ANY_TAINT': 'MUST'}.get(pattern['tail'], pattern['tail']),
            'markKind': pattern['mark']['kind'], 'pathLength': len(pattern['path']),
            'hasExclusions': bool(pattern['E']), 'layer': admission['layer'],
            'fineTailCandidate': pattern['tail'] in {'STAR', 'EXACT', 'ANY_TAINT'}}


def read_json(path):
    return loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else None


def controls(directory, capture_path, marker_counts, reasons):
    metadata = {}
    for name in ('manifest.json', 'progress-evidence.json', 'overlay-runtime-verification.json', 'artifact-hashes.json'):
        path = directory / name
        try:
            metadata[name] = read_json(path)
            if metadata[name] is not None and not isinstance(metadata[name], dict):
                reasons.append('BAD_CONTROL_STRUCTURE:' + name)
                metadata[name] = None
        except (ValueError, OSError) as error:
            reasons.append('BAD_CONTROL_FILE:' + name + ':' + str(error))
        if metadata.get(name) is None:
            reasons.append('MISSING_CONTROL_FILE:' + name)
    manifest, progress, runtime, artifacts = (metadata.get(n) or {} for n in
        ('manifest.json', 'progress-evidence.json', 'overlay-runtime-verification.json', 'artifact-hashes.json'))
    if manifest.get('state') != 'COMMAND_ENDED': reasons.append('COMMAND_NOT_ENDED')
    if manifest.get('controllerError') is not None: reasons.append('CONTROLLER_ERROR')
    if manifest.get('ownedAnalyzerStillAlive') is not False: reasons.append('ANALYZER_LIFETIME_UNPROVEN')
    if manifest.get('run4StartProvesAcceptedForward3') is not True: reasons.append('NO_MANIFEST_ACCEPTED_F3')
    lines = progress.get('sourceControlLines', [])
    if not isinstance(lines, list) or not all(isinstance(line, str) for line in lines):
        reasons.append('BAD_NATIVE_CONTROL_LINES')
        lines = []
    if not any(re.search(r'\bBIDI_RUN_START run=3 direction=FORWARD limit=2(?:\s|$)', l) for l in lines):
        reasons.append('NO_NATIVE_F3_START')
    if not any(re.search(r'\bBIDI_RUN_END run=3 status=COMPLETE(?:\s|$)', l) for l in lines):
        reasons.append('NO_NATIVE_F3_COMPLETE')
    if not any(re.search(r'\bBIDI_RUN_START run=4 direction=BACKWARD limit=3(?:\s|$)', l) for l in lines):
        reasons.append('NO_NATIVE_B4_START')
    if runtime.get('exactAcquiredAnalyzerArgvVerified') is not True: reasons.append('ANALYZER_ARGV_UNPROVEN')
    if runtime.get('nativeRuntimeTreesStillMatchAfterCommand') is not True: reasons.append('NATIVE_RUNTIME_PIN_UNPROVEN')
    loaded = runtime.get('classLoad') or {}
    if not isinstance(loaded, dict) or loaded.get('status') != 'PASS': reasons.append('LOADED_OVERLAY_UNPROVEN')
    observed = manifest.get('capture') or {}
    if not isinstance(observed, dict):
        reasons.append('BAD_OBSERVER_CONTROL_STRUCTURE')
        observed = {}
    for key in ('invalidJSONMarkerLines', 'partialFinalBytes'):
        if observed.get(key) != 0: reasons.append('OBSERVER_' + key.upper())
    if 'admissionCaptureIntegrity' in observed:
        if observed.get('admissionCaptureIntegrity') != 'PASS_FOR_RECORDED_EVENTS': reasons.append('ADMISSION_CAPTURE_INTEGRITY_UNPROVEN')
        if observed.get('oversizedUnclassifiedOrAdmissionLinesSkipped') != 0: reasons.append('UNSAFE_OVERSIZED_OBSERVER_LINES')
        if observed.get('oversizedLineRecordsDropped') != 0: reasons.append('OVERSIZED_LINE_AUDIT_CAP')
        if observed.get('sourceCapAnnounced') is not False: reasons.append('SOURCE_CAP_CONTROL')
        if observed.get('captureInvalidReasons') != []: reasons.append('CAPTURE_INVALID_CONTROL_REASONS')
        ordinary, unsafe, total = (observed.get(k) for k in ('oversizedOrdinaryDebugFrontiersSkipped',
            'oversizedUnclassifiedOrAdmissionLinesSkipped', 'oversizedObserverLinesSkipped'))
        if not all(type(v) is int and v >= 0 for v in (ordinary, unsafe, total)) or ordinary + unsafe != total:
            reasons.append('OVERSIZED_LINE_CLASSIFICATION_MISMATCH')
    elif observed.get('oversizedObserverLinesSkipped') != 0:
        reasons.append('OBSERVER_OVERSIZEDOBSERVERLINESSKIPPED')
    if observed.get('markerCounts') != dict(marker_counts): reasons.append('OBSERVER_MARKER_COUNT_MISMATCH')
    final_files = artifacts.get('files') or {}
    if not isinstance(final_files, dict):
        reasons.append('BAD_FINAL_ARTIFACT_PIN_STRUCTURE')
        final_files = {}
    for name in ('admission-capture.jsonl', 'manifest.json', 'progress-evidence.json', 'overlay-runtime-verification.json'):
        path = directory / name
        pin = final_files.get(name)
        if not path.is_file() or not isinstance(pin, dict) or pin.get('sha256') != file_sha(path) or pin.get('bytes') != path.stat().st_size:
            reasons.append('FINAL_ARTIFACT_PIN_UNPROVEN:' + name)
    plan = None
    planvalue = manifest.get('plan')
    if not isinstance(planvalue, str): reasons.append('BAD_OR_MISSING_PLAN_PATH')
    planpath = pathlib.Path(planvalue if isinstance(planvalue, str) else '/missing')
    if planpath.is_file():
        try:
            plan = read_json(planpath)
            if not isinstance(plan, dict):
                reasons.append('PLAN_STRUCTURE_INVALID')
                plan = None
            if file_sha(planpath) != manifest.get('planSha256'): reasons.append('PLAN_PIN_MISMATCH')
        except (ValueError, OSError): reasons.append('PLAN_INVALID')
    else:
        reasons.append('PLAN_MISSING')
    return {'state': 'PASS' if not reasons else 'UNKNOWN', 'variant': manifest.get('variant'),
            'manifest': str(directory / 'manifest.json'), 'nativeControlLineCount': len(lines),
            'acceptedForward3': manifest.get('run4StartProvesAcceptedForward3') is True,
            'identityPrerequisites': {key: plan.get(key) for key in
                ('mainConfigurationSha256', 'testRevision', 'productionSourceAggregateSha256', 'configuration')}
                if plan else None}


def accept_positive_control_audit(path, directory, reasons):
    """Bind an explicit external audit; resolve only two known false control flags."""
    audit_path = pathlib.Path(path).resolve()
    audit = read_json(audit_path)
    require(isinstance(audit, dict) and audit.get('schema') == 'conductor-admission-positive-control-audit-v1',
            'Positive audit schema mismatch')
    require(audit.get('state') == 'PASS', 'Positive audit is not PASS')
    require(pathlib.Path(audit.get('attemptDirectory', '')).resolve() == directory, 'Positive audit attempt mismatch')
    allowed = {'LOADED_OVERLAY_UNPROVEN', 'OBSERVER_OVERSIZEDOBSERVERLINESSKIPPED'}
    resolved = audit.get('resolvedUnknownReasons')
    require(isinstance(resolved, list) and set(resolved) <= allowed, 'Audit attempts to resolve unsupported reasons')
    required_checks = ('hiddenLambdaHostsVerified', 'allRealAdmissionClassOriginsVerified',
                       'oversizedLinesAreOrdinaryAndContainNoAdmissionMarkers', 'rawAdmissionMarkerExtractionExact')
    checks = audit.get('checks')
    require(isinstance(checks, dict) and all(checks.get(k) is True for k in required_checks), 'Audit checks are incomplete')
    raw = audit.get('rawInputs')
    require(isinstance(raw, dict), 'Missing audit raw pins')
    required = {'analyzer.log', 'class-load.log', 'admission-capture.jsonl', 'manifest.json',
                'overlay-runtime-verification.json', 'progress-evidence.json'}
    require(required <= set(raw), 'Audit raw input pins incomplete')
    for name, pin in raw.items():
        require(isinstance(pin, dict), 'Bad audit input pin')
        source = pathlib.Path(pin.get('path', '')).resolve()
        require(source == directory / name and source.is_file(), 'Audit source path mismatch')
        require(pin.get('sha256') == file_sha(source) and pin.get('bytes') == source.stat().st_size,
                'Audit raw input changed: ' + name)
    full = audit.get('fullAudit')
    require(isinstance(full, dict), 'Missing full audit binding')
    full_path = pathlib.Path(full.get('path', '')).resolve()
    require(full_path.is_file() and full.get('sha256') == file_sha(full_path), 'Full audit hash mismatch')
    require(audit.get('absentRows') == 'UNKNOWN', 'Audit must preserve absence uncertainty')
    return {'path': str(audit_path), 'sha256': file_sha(audit_path), 'fullAudit': full,
            'resolvedReasons': sorted(set(resolved) & set(reasons)), 'positiveEventsOnly': True,
            'absentRows': 'UNKNOWN'}


def decode(path, control_audit=None):
    path = pathlib.Path(path).resolve()
    capture_path = path / 'admission-capture.jsonl' if path.is_dir() else path
    directory = capture_path.parent
    events, invalid, records, reasons = [], [], [], []
    marker_counts = collections.Counter()
    hash_ = hashlib.sha256()
    snapshot_size = capture_path.stat().st_size if capture_path.is_file() else 0
    if not capture_path.is_file(): reasons.append('CAPTURE_FILE_MISSING')
    require(snapshot_size <= 1073741824, 'Capture input exceeds 1 GiB read bound')
    if capture_path.is_file():
        offset = 0
        with capture_path.open('rb') as stream:
            for line_number in range(1, 20001):
                left = snapshot_size - offset
                if left <= 0: break
                raw = stream.readline(min(left, 8388609))
                reference = {'file': str(capture_path), 'line': line_number, 'byteOffset': offset,
                             'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
                offset += len(raw)
                hash_.update(raw)
                try:
                    require(raw.endswith(b'\n'), 'Partial or oversized JSONL record')
                    require(len(raw) <= 8388608, 'JSONL record exceeds 8 MiB bound')
                    wrapper = loads(raw.decode('utf-8'))
                    marker, payload = wrapper.get('marker'), wrapper.get('payload')
                    require(marker in {CAPTURE, DROP, STATS} and isinstance(payload, dict), 'Invalid JSONL wrapper')
                    marker_counts[marker] += 1
                    require(payload.get('schema') == SCHEMA, 'Unknown control/event schema')
                    records.append({'marker': marker, 'raw': reference, 'sequence': payload.get('sequence'),
                                    'phase': payload.get('phase'), 'reason': payload.get('reason')})
                    if marker == CAPTURE:
                        normalizer = Normalizer(payload)
                        event = normalizer.event(reference)
                        events.append(event)
                        counters = normalizer.native
                    else:
                        counters = payload
                    if marker == DROP: reasons.append('WHOLE_DROP_PRESENT')
                    if marker == STATS and payload.get('phase') == 'CAP': reasons.append('CAP_PRESENT')
                    for key in ERROR_COUNTERS:
                        if counters.get(key) != 0: reasons.append('NONZERO_OR_MISSING_COUNTER:' + key)
                    if marker == STATS:
                        if payload.get('callerKeyFilter') != 'ALL_CONTEXTS_AND_PREMISES_AT_SELECTED_CALLER_METHOD' or payload.get('callIndexFilter') != '9_ROOT':
                            reasons.append('WRONG_FIXED_CALL_SELECTOR')
                        if payload.get('offerFilter') != 'EXACT_SINGLE_HEAD_NORMAL_MUST_GRAAL_WORKFLOW_DEFINITION': reasons.append('WRONG_OFFER_SELECTOR')
                        if payload.get('maxExplicitRows') != 4096: reasons.append('WRONG_EXPLICIT_ROW_BOUND')
                        if not isinstance(payload.get('calleeMethodSelector'), str): reasons.append('MISSING_UPSTREAM_SELECTOR_SETTINGS')
                        if type(payload.get('limit')) is not int or type(payload.get('attempted')) is not int:
                            reasons.append('BAD_EVENT_LIMIT_CONTROL')
                        elif payload['attempted'] >= payload['limit']:
                            reasons.append('EVENT_LIMIT_SATURATION')
                except (Invalid, ValueError, UnicodeError, KeyError, TypeError, AttributeError, IndexError, RecursionError) as error:
                    invalid.append({'raw': reference, 'reason': str(error)})
                    reasons.append('INVALID_WHOLE_EVENT_OR_CONTROL')
            else:
                reasons.append('READER_RECORD_CAP')
        if offset != snapshot_size: reasons.append('UNREAD_CAPTURE_BYTES')
    sequences = [event['sequence'] for event in events]
    if sequences != list(range(1, len(events) + 1)): reasons.append('MISSING_DUPLICATE_OR_REORDERED_EVENT_SEQUENCE')
    if not events: reasons.append('NO_COMPLETE_EVENTS')
    if any(not item['snapshotConstant'] for item in snapshot_summary(events)):
        reasons.append('FROZEN_SNAPSHOT_CHANGED_WITHIN_VARIANT')
    if not any(r['marker'] == STATS and r['phase'] == 'START' for r in records): reasons.append('NO_START_SETTINGS')
    evidence = controls(directory, capture_path, marker_counts, reasons)
    accepted_audit = None
    if control_audit is not None:
        try:
            accepted_audit = accept_positive_control_audit(control_audit, directory, reasons)
            reasons = [r for r in reasons if r not in accepted_audit['resolvedReasons']]
            evidence['positiveControlAudit'] = accepted_audit
            if not reasons: evidence['state'] = 'POSITIVE_EVENT_CONTROLS_AUDITED'
        except (Invalid, OSError, ValueError, TypeError) as error:
            reasons.append('CONTROL_AUDIT_REJECTED:' + str(error))
    return {'schema': 'opentaint.conductor-must-demand-snapshot-decoded.v1',
            'state': ('AUDITED_POSITIVE_CALL_EVENTS' if accepted_audit else 'COMPLETE_CALL_CAPTURE') if not reasons else 'UNKNOWN',
            'absentRows': 'UNKNOWN',
            'unknownReasons': sorted(set(reasons)), 'limits': LIMITS,
            'source': {'file': str(capture_path), 'snapshotBytes': snapshot_size, 'snapshotSha256': hash_.hexdigest(),
                       'existed': capture_path.is_file()}, 'controls': evidence,
            'counts': {'validEvents': len(events), 'invalidRecords': len(invalid), 'markerCounts': dict(marker_counts),
                       'uniqueInputKeys': len({e['semanticInputDigest'] for e in events}),
                       'uniqueAdmissionQueries': len({e['admissionQueryDigest'] for e in events}),
                       'returnedInitials': sum(len(e['initialOrder']) for e in events),
                       'emptyReturnedLists': sum(not e['initialOrder'] for e in events),
                       'physicalDagNodes': sum(e['physicalDagNodes'] for e in events), 'logicalPathsEnumerated': 0},
            'events': events, 'invalidRecords': invalid, 'controlRecords': records,
            'demandSnapshotSummary': snapshot_summary(events)}


def groups(events):
    result = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for event in events: result[event['semanticInputDigest']].append(event)
    return result


def query_groups(events):
    result = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for event in events: result[event['admissionQueryDigest']].append(event)
    return result


def compare_admission_queries(current, paired):
    a, b = query_groups(current['events']), query_groups(paired['events'])
    differences, ambiguous, matched = [], [], []
    for key in sorted(a.keys() & b.keys()):
        left, right = a[key], b[key]
        require(left[0]['admissionQuery'] == right[0]['admissionQuery'], 'Admission query hash collision')
        item = {'admissionQueryDigest': key, 'currentOccurrences': len(left), 'pairedBOccurrences': len(right),
                'currentRaw': [e['raw'] for e in left], 'pairedBRaw': [e['raw'] for e in right]}
        matched.append(item)
        aa, bb = {e['initialSetDigest'] for e in left}, {e['initialSetDigest'] for e in right}
        if len(aa) != 1 or len(bb) != 1:
            ambiguous.append(dict(item, reason='Same query returns multiple sets within a variant'))
            continue
        aset, bset = {canonical(v): v for v in left[0]['initialSet']}, {canonical(v): v for v in right[0]['initialSet']}
        extra_b, extra_a = sorted(bset.keys() - aset.keys()), sorted(aset.keys() - bset.keys())
        if extra_b or extra_a:
            differences.append(dict(item, admissionQuery=left[0]['admissionQuery'],
                currentFullInputKeys=sorted({e['semanticInputDigest'] for e in left}),
                pairedBFullInputKeys=sorted({e['semanticInputDigest'] for e in right}),
                extraPairedB=[{'admission': bset[k], 'classification': classify(bset[k])} for k in extra_b],
                extraCurrent=[{'admission': aset[k], 'classification': classify(aset[k])} for k in extra_a]))
    return {'scope': 'run/config plus full callee key and complete structural actualFacts; caller, P, scope and callsite are excluded',
            'counts': {'matchingQueryKeys': len(matched), 'differentReturnedSetQueryKeys': len(differences),
                       'ambiguousQueryKeys': len(ambiguous), 'onlyCurrentQueryKeys': len(a.keys() - b.keys()),
                       'onlyPairedBQueryKeys': len(b.keys() - a.keys())},
            'matchingQueries': matched, 'differentQueries': differences, 'ambiguousQueries': ambiguous,
            'absentRows': 'UNKNOWN', 'denotationalEquivalenceChecked': False}


def returned_union(events):
    result = {}
    for event in events:
        for ordinal, admission in enumerate(event['initialOrder']):
            value = {'callee': event['semanticInput']['callee'], 'admission': admission}
            key = canonical(value)
            result.setdefault(key, dict(value, representative={'sequence': event['sequence'], 'raw': event['raw'],
                'semanticInputDigest': event['semanticInputDigest'], 'admissionQueryDigest': event['admissionQueryDigest'],
                'localInitialId': event['localReturnedInitialIds'][ordinal]}, deliveryScope=event['calleeInitialDeliveryScope']))
    return result


def initial_associations(initials, events):
    consumers = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for event in events:
        caller = event['semanticInput']['caller']
        for member in event['localOriginalPremiseMembers']:
            consumers[(canonical(caller), member['localId'], canonical(member['pattern']))].append(event)
    for item in initials:
        lookup = (canonical(item['callee']), item['representative']['localInitialId'], canonical(item['admission']['pattern']))
        candidates = [e for e in consumers.get(lookup, []) if e['sequence'] > item['representative']['sequence']]
        item['laterPremiseIdentityAssociations'] = []
        for event in candidates[:8]:
            key = event['semanticInput']
            root = key['callerScopeBlock'] == 0 and key['callerScopeEntry'] == -1
            item['laterPremiseIdentityAssociations'].append({'sequence': event['sequence'], 'raw': event['raw'],
                'semanticInputDigest': event['semanticInputDigest'], 'callee': key['callee'],
                'callerScope': {'block': key['callerScopeBlock'], 'entry': key['callerScopeEntry']},
                'deliveryScope': item['deliveryScope'], 'scopeMatchesMethodRootDelivery': root,
                'scopePropagationStatus': 'ROOT_SCOPE_MATCH' if root else 'BLOCK_PROPAGATION_UNPROVEN',
                'methodContextInitialIdAndPatternMatch': True, 'uniqueDeliveryOrCausalityProven': False})
        item['associationCandidates'] = len(candidates)
        item['associationRecordsTruncated'] = len(candidates) > 8
    return initials


def compare_returned_unions(current, paired):
    a, b = returned_union(current['events']), returned_union(paired['events'])
    extra_b = initial_associations([b[k] for k in sorted(b.keys() - a.keys())], paired['events'])
    extra_a = [a[k] for k in sorted(a.keys() - b.keys())]
    return {'scope': 'full callee key and returned pattern/layer only; union of recorded call returns, not global callee history',
            'counts': {'currentUnion': len(a), 'pairedBUnion': len(b), 'extraPairedB': len(extra_b), 'extraCurrent': len(extra_a)},
            'extraPairedB': extra_b, 'extraCurrent': extra_a, 'absentRows': 'UNKNOWN'}


def compare(current, paired):
    a, b = groups(current['events']), groups(paired['events'])
    matched, differences, ambiguous = [], [], []
    for key in sorted(a.keys() & b.keys()):
        left, right = a[key], b[key]
        require(left[0]['semanticInput'] == right[0]['semanticInput'], 'Semantic key hash collision')
        item = {'semanticInputDigest': key, 'currentRaw': [e['raw'] for e in left], 'pairedBRaw': [e['raw'] for e in right],
                'currentOccurrences': len(left), 'pairedBOccurrences': len(right)}
        matched.append(item)
        if len({e['initialSetDigest'] for e in left}) != 1 or len({e['initialSetDigest'] for e in right}) != 1:
            ambiguous.append(dict(item, reason='Repeated identical input has multiple returned sets'))
            continue
        aa = {canonical(v): v for v in left[0]['initialSet']}
        bb = {canonical(v): v for v in right[0]['initialSet']}
        extra_b = [bb[k] for k in sorted(bb.keys() - aa.keys())]
        extra_current = [aa[k] for k in sorted(aa.keys() - bb.keys())]
        left_orders, right_orders = {e['initialOrderDigest'] for e in left}, {e['initialOrderDigest'] for e in right}
        if extra_b or extra_current or left_orders != right_orders:
            differences.append(dict(item, semanticInput=left[0]['semanticInput'],
                extraPairedB=[{'admission': v, 'classification': classify(v)} for v in extra_b],
                extraCurrent=[{'admission': v, 'classification': classify(v)} for v in extra_current],
                orderingOnly=not extra_b and not extra_current, currentOrderingDigests=sorted(left_orders),
                pairedBOrderingDigests=sorted(right_orders)))
    prerequisites_a, prerequisites_b = current['controls'].get('identityPrerequisites'), paired['controls'].get('identityPrerequisites')
    same_prerequisites = bool(prerequisites_a) and prerequisites_a == prerequisites_b and all(
        prerequisites_a.get(k) is not None for k in ('mainConfigurationSha256', 'testRevision', 'productionSourceAggregateSha256', 'configuration'))
    reasons = []
    usable_states = {'COMPLETE_CALL_CAPTURE', 'AUDITED_POSITIVE_CALL_EVENTS'}
    if current['state'] not in usable_states: reasons.append('CURRENT_CAPTURE_UNKNOWN')
    if paired['state'] not in usable_states: reasons.append('PAIRED_B_CAPTURE_UNKNOWN')
    if not same_prerequisites: reasons.append('CROSS_JVM_IDENTITY_PREREQUISITES_UNPROVEN')
    if ambiguous: reasons.append('NONDETERMINISTIC_REPEATED_INPUT_RESULTS')
    query_comparison = compare_admission_queries(current, paired)
    if query_comparison['counts']['ambiguousQueryKeys']: reasons.append('MULTIPLE_RESULTS_FOR_SAME_ADMISSION_QUERY')
    snapshot_comparison = compare_snapshots(current, paired)
    if snapshot_comparison['counts']['ambiguousQueries']: reasons.append('MULTIPLE_FROZEN_SNAPSHOTS_FOR_SAME_QUERY')
    return {'schema': 'opentaint.conductor-must-demand-snapshot-comparison.v1',
            'state': 'OBSERVED_CALL_LEVEL_COMPARISON' if not reasons else 'UNKNOWN', 'unknownReasons': reasons,
            'absentRows': 'UNKNOWN',
            'limits': LIMITS, 'crossJvmIdentityPrerequisitesEqual': same_prerequisites,
            'current': {k: current[k] for k in ('source', 'state', 'counts', 'unknownReasons', 'controls')},
            'pairedB': {k: paired[k] for k in ('source', 'state', 'counts', 'unknownReasons', 'controls')},
            'counts': {'matchingInputKeys': len(matched), 'differentMatchedInputKeys': len(differences),
                       'ambiguousMatchedInputKeys': len(ambiguous), 'onlyCurrentInputKeys': len(a.keys() - b.keys()),
                       'onlyPairedBInputKeys': len(b.keys() - a.keys()),
                       'extraPairedBInitials': sum(len(d['extraPairedB']) for d in differences),
                       'extraCurrentInitials': sum(len(d['extraCurrent']) for d in differences),
                       'extraPairedBTailClasses': dict(collections.Counter(v['classification']['tailClass'] for d in differences for v in d['extraPairedB']))},
            'matchedInputs': matched, 'differentMatchedCalls': differences, 'ambiguousMatchedCalls': ambiguous,
            'admissionQueryComparison': query_comparison,
            'returnedInitialUnionComparison': compare_returned_unions(current, paired),
            'demandSnapshotComparison': snapshot_comparison,
            'onlyCurrent': [{'semanticInputDigest': k, 'raw': [e['raw'] for e in a[k]]} for k in sorted(a.keys() - b.keys())],
            'onlyPairedB': [{'semanticInputDigest': k, 'raw': [e['raw'] for e in b[k]]} for k in sorted(b.keys() - a.keys())]}


def safe_output(path, inputs):
    output = pathlib.Path(path).resolve()
    require('/preparation/' not in str(output), 'Refuse output in any sealed preparation directory')
    for value in inputs:
        item = pathlib.Path(value).resolve()
        directory = item if item.is_dir() else item.parent
        require(output != directory and directory not in output.parents, 'Refuse writes inside input attempt directory')
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return output


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest='action', required=True)
    inspect = sub.add_parser('inspect', help='Validate and normalize one capture or attempt directory')
    inspect.add_argument('input')
    inspect.add_argument('--output', required=True)
    inspect.add_argument('--control-audit', help='Explicit positive external audit; default remains fail-closed')
    paired = sub.add_parser('compare', help='Compare full semantic input matches; preserve ordering separately')
    paired.add_argument('--current', required=True)
    paired.add_argument('--paired-b', required=True)
    paired.add_argument('--output', required=True)
    paired.add_argument('--current-control-audit')
    paired.add_argument('--paired-b-control-audit')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.action == 'inspect':
        result = decode(args.input, args.control_audit)
        inputs = [args.input]
    else:
        result = compare(decode(args.current, args.current_control_audit), decode(args.paired_b, args.paired_b_control_audit))
        inputs = [args.current, args.paired_b]
    output = safe_output(args.output, inputs)
    output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
    summary = {'state': result['state'], 'counts': result['counts'], 'unknownReasons': result['unknownReasons'],
               'output': str(output)}
    if 'admissionQueryComparison' in result:
        summary['admissionQueryCounts'] = result['admissionQueryComparison']['counts']
        summary['returnedUnionCounts'] = result['returnedInitialUnionComparison']['counts']
    print(json.dumps(summary, sort_keys=True))
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        sys.exit(main())
    except (Invalid, OSError, ValueError) as error:
        print(json.dumps({'state': 'UNKNOWN', 'error': str(error)}), file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only native-record and synthetic negative controls; no analyzer execution."""
import copy
import json
import pathlib
import tempfile
import unittest

import decode

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def fixture():
    return json.loads((ROOT / 'test-fixture-envelope.json').read_text())


def mutate(event, action):
    event = copy.deepcopy(event)
    native = json.loads(event['nativeEvent'])
    action(native)
    event['nativeEvent'] = json.dumps(native)
    return event


def normalized(event):
    return decode.Normalizer(event).event({'file': 'synthetic', 'line': 1})


def decoded(event):
    return {'events': [event], 'source': {'file': 'synthetic'}, 'state': 'COMPLETE_CALL_CAPTURE', 'counts': {},
            'unknownReasons': [], 'controls': {'identityPrerequisites': {'mainConfigurationSha256': 'config',
                'testRevision': 'IR', 'productionSourceAggregateSha256': 'source', 'configuration': {'same': True}}}}


def add_child_row_and_initial(native):
    ordinal = native['explicitDemandRowCount']
    row = copy.deepcopy(native['explicitDemandRow.15.entry'])
    field = next(member['path'][0] for key, value in native.items() if key.startswith('admittedInitial.') and
                 key.endswith('.initial') for member in value['members'])
    row['path'] = [field]
    native[f'explicitDemandRow.{ordinal}.entry'] = row
    native[f'explicitDemandRow.{ordinal}.hasExit'] = True
    native[f'explicitDemandRow.{ordinal}.exit'] = copy.deepcopy(native['explicitDemandRow.15.exit'])
    native['explicitDemandRowCount'] += 1
    native['explicitDemandPairedRowCount'] += 1
    source = next(copy.deepcopy(value) for key, value in native.items() if key.startswith('admittedInitial.') and
                  key.endswith('.initial') and value['members'][0]['mark']['kind'] == 'FLOW')
    source['members'][0].update(id=999999, tail='ANY_TAINT')
    index = native['admittedInitialCount']
    native[f'admittedInitial.{index}.initial'] = source
    native[f'admittedInitial.{index}.layer'] = 'NORMAL'
    native['admittedInitialCount'] += 1


class SnapshotDecoderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_complete_native_rows_and_two_node_actual(self):
        event = normalized(fixture())
        self.assertEqual(event['demandSnapshot']['rowCount'], 77)
        self.assertEqual(event['demandSnapshot']['pairedRowCount'], 77)
        self.assertEqual(event['physicalDagNodes'], 2)
        self.assertEqual(event['logicalPathsEnumerated'], 0)
        self.assertEqual([r['ordinal'] for r in event['flowAnyCoordinateRows']], [15, 30])

    def test_partial_projection_and_bad_row_counts_invalidate_whole_event(self):
        changes = [('completeExplicitLocalRows', False), ('demandSnapshotHasStaticCompletion', True),
                   ('demandSnapshotHasSharedStaticCarry', True), ('demandSnapshotTargetEntryRowsOmitted', False),
                   ('explicitDemandRowCount', 78), ('explicitDemandPairedRowCount', 76),
                   ('explicitDemandEntryOnlyRowCount', 1), ('explicitDemandRowCount', 4097)]
        for key, value in changes:
            with self.subTest(key=key, value=value), self.assertRaises(decode.Invalid):
                normalized(mutate(fixture(), lambda n: n.update({key: value})))

    def test_missing_or_extra_paired_exit_invalidates_whole_event(self):
        for action in (lambda n: n.pop('explicitDemandRow.15.exit'),
                       lambda n: n.update({'explicitDemandRow.15.hasExit': False}),
                       lambda n: n.update({'explicitDemandRow.77.entry': n['explicitDemandRow.15.entry']})):
            with self.assertRaises(decode.Invalid):
                normalized(mutate(fixture(), action))

    def test_explicit_entry_only_rows_are_preserved(self):
        def action(n):
            n.pop('explicitDemandRow.15.exit')
            n['explicitDemandRow.15.hasExit'] = False
            n['explicitDemandPairedRowCount'] -= 1
            n['explicitDemandEntryOnlyRowCount'] += 1
        event = normalized(mutate(fixture(), action))
        self.assertIsNone(event['demandSnapshot']['rowsInOrder'][15]['exit'])

    def test_missing_full_field_type_has_no_short_name_fallback(self):
        event = fixture()
        del event['typedField.0.fieldType']
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(decode.Invalid, 'fieldType'):
            normalized(event)

    def test_row_pairing_and_order_are_not_flattened(self):
        before = normalized(fixture())
        def action(n):
            n['explicitDemandRow.15.exit'], n['explicitDemandRow.30.exit'] = (
                n['explicitDemandRow.30.exit'], n['explicitDemandRow.15.exit'])
        after = normalized(mutate(fixture(), action))
        self.assertEqual(before['demandSnapshot']['rowSetDigest'], after['demandSnapshot']['rowSetDigest'])
        self.assertNotEqual(before['demandSnapshot']['rowOrderDigest'], after['demandSnapshot']['rowOrderDigest'])
        changed = normalized(mutate(fixture(), lambda n: n['explicitDemandRow.15.exit'].update(tail='STAR')))
        self.assertNotEqual(before['demandSnapshot']['rowSetDigest'], changed['demandSnapshot']['rowSetDigest'])

    def test_child_guide_comparison_keeps_matching_paired_exit(self):
        a = normalized(fixture())
        b = normalized(mutate(fixture(), add_child_row_and_initial))
        result = decode.compare(decoded(a), decoded(b))
        rows = result['demandSnapshotComparison']
        self.assertEqual(rows['counts']['matchingQueries'], 1)
        self.assertEqual(rows['counts']['rootChildEqualExitPairs'], 1)
        pair = rows['matches'][0]['rootAndChildRowsWithSamePairedExit'][0]
        self.assertEqual(pair['currentRootRow']['ordinal'], 15)
        self.assertFalse(pair['emissionAttributionObserved'])
        self.assertEqual(result['counts']['extraPairedBTailClasses'], {'MUST': 1})

    def test_different_paired_exit_is_not_a_frontier_pair(self):
        def action(n):
            add_child_row_and_initial(n)
            n[f"explicitDemandRow.{n['explicitDemandRowCount'] - 1}.exit"]['tail'] = 'STAR'
        result = decode.compare(decoded(normalized(fixture())), decoded(normalized(mutate(fixture(), action))))
        self.assertEqual(result['demandSnapshotComparison']['counts']['rootChildEqualExitPairs'], 0)

    def test_callee_native_context_is_part_of_comparison_key(self):
        a = normalized(fixture())

import json

OUTPUT = WORKSPACE / 'docs/reports/data/bidirectional-conductor-must-demand-snapshot-20261106.json'


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def pin(path):
    return dict(path=str(path), sha256=sha(path), bytes=path.stat().st_size)


def main():
    selected = json.loads((ROOT / 'selected-snapshot-witness.json').read_text())
    assert all(selected['checks'].values())
    records = {}
    checks = []
    for side in ('current', 'pairedB'):

        raw = (attempt / 'admission-capture.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True)[1]
        assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == event['raw']['sha256']
        wrapper = json.loads(raw)

        assert row_count == native['explicitDemandPairedRowCount'] and native['explicitDemandEntryOnlyRowCount'] == 0
        for ordinal in range(row_count):
            assert native[f'explicitDemandRow.{ordinal}.hasExit'] is True
            assert isinstance(native[f'explicitDemandRow.{ordinal}.entry'], dict)
            assert isinstance(native[f'explicitDemandRow.{ordinal}.exit'], dict)

            'noStaticCompletionOrCarry', 'allPairedExitsPresent', 'terminalManifest', 'acceptedF3', 'runtimePinsAndOrigins')])
    code = {}
    for name in ('decode.py', 'test_decoder.py', 'package-snapshot-report.py', 'baseline-RestrictedInitialPolicy.kt.txt'):
        path = ROOT / name
        code[name] = dict(pin(path), source=path.read_text())

                   'selectedWitnessCount': len(selected['checks']), 'decoderTests': 12},

    print(json.dumps({'state': 'PASS', 'output': str(OUTPUT), 'bytes': OUTPUT.stat().st_size,
                      'sha256': sha(OUTPUT), 'packagingChecks': len(checks)}))
